versions.changelog:
- Initial release: generate animated (GIF/MP4) trend charts from time-series JSON data
- Supports up to 4 data series with distinct colors and min/max markers
- Outputs: animation.gif, animation.mp4 (if ffmpeg available), and static overview.png
- Features professional dark theme and responsive date axis formatting
- Command-line options for title, fps, size, and output directory
- Includes multi-panel overview grid and support for custom fonts
